title: PublicResearchEvidence
description: Public-only verified research evidence schema for CIO decision evaluation. Fixtures, simulated items, and unverified narratives are strictly rejected.

research_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the research piece (e.g. nvda-repurchase-20260928-official)

source_url.description: Publicly resolvable HTTPS/HTTP URL of the primary source

source_tier.description: Tier ranking of the source. Unverified community sources are rejected.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this evidence was retrieved

is_fixture.description: Must be false for production evidence. Labeled fixtures are strictly rejected.

verification_status.description: Must be 'verified'. Unverified narratives or speculations are strictly rejected.

verified_facts.description: List of verifiable factual claims extracted directly from the source

limitations.description: Explicit gaps, timing discrepancies, or non-inferences
